name: Going To Clubs
overview: Scripture calls believers to live in a way that reflects Christ’s light to others, encouraging good works that glorify God rather than seeking the approval of men. As followers of Christ, we are entrusted to care for the church and remain faithful to God’s truth, resisting worldly influences that might compromise our witness. This commitment requires discernment and a focus on pleasing God above all, which challenges the pursuit of activities that may not align with our calling as servants of Christ.
